Reflecting on it, we suspect the sandwich was excessively salty due to over-seasoning. The wait time was short, only 5-7 minutes, but it seemed like there was a lack of care in preparation. My wife was hung up on twice before finally speaking with a manager, who is also the owner. Unfortunately, the response was equally dismissive and rude.
